cover.label: LAS VEGAS NEWS
cover.sub: Pending sales vs. a year ago

details.label: THE DETAILS
bullets: Las Vegas pending sales are down 22.7% from a year ago
That's one of the biggest drops of any major U.S. metro
U.S. prices dipped for the first time in 3 years

details.label: FOR OWNERS
bullets: 7,995 Vegas single-family homes had no offer at the end of September
That's up 6.6% from a year ago
Supply is near five months, up from four

cta.sub: If your home isn't moving, IRES can help you lease and manage it.
